steps: We inspect the house and record the condition of structures and engineering.
We create a design project or work to yours and prepare drawings.
If we carry out the renovation to our design, amount and stages are fixed: the total stays within 5% of the estimate.
Networks are laid before finishing — so nothing has to be chiselled out later.
Finishing works, with furnishing direct from China in parallel. Photo reports every 1–2 weeks via Telegram.
Cleaning, certificate of completion, warranty obligations under the contract.
faq: How much does a turnkey house renovation cost?
From $550 per m². The exact amount depends on the condition of the house, the engineering and the finish level — we fix it in the estimate after inspection.
Do you work in the Kyiv region?
Yes: Kyiv and the region — Irpin, Bucha, Brovary, Boryspil, Obukhiv and other towns. We also work across Ukraine, in Europe and worldwide.
Can the estimate grow during the renovation?
If we carry out the renovation to our design, we guarantee the total will not deviate from the approved estimate by more than 5%. Extra works only with your written approval.
Can I follow the renovation without coming to the site?
Yes, we send photo reports every 1–2 weeks via Telegram.
